reflection: Volume-surge factors help in 2023 and 2025 but fail in 2022 and 2024, for both models; nothing has passed the team bar. Return-based relative moves flip sign across regimes. I will try making volume signals less regime dependent (rank-like via multi-window, differences between short and long baselines) and new ideas around price-volume interaction, QQQ-relative gap/trend, and MSFT/NVDA divergence from QQQ. Also test ranges with longer normalization to be robust in 2022 vs 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_vs_peer_volume_5d_smooth
lessons.lesson: Smoothing volume over 3 days removed the one-day attention spike that carried the signal, so the gain vanished.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge
lessons.lesson: Apple volume surge relative to QQQ helped both models in 2023 and 2025 but failed in 2022 and 2024, similar to the NVDA version so it is regime dependent.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_change_signed_by_trend
lessons.lesson: Short-vs-long QQQ volume zscore difference was a slow market-level measure with no predictive information for Apple in any year.

lessons.name: aapl_high_vs_prev_close_gap
lessons.lesson: Upside-minus-downside excursion from prior close is almost the same as the daily return (0.89 similarity) and added noise, hurting 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_surge_vol_state
lessons.lesson: QQQ short/long volatility ratio is a rescaled vol factor that only helped in 2025 and was noise elsewhere.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_qqq_with_volume_confirm
lessons.lesson: Multiplying relative return by NVDA volume z-score created a noisy interaction dominated by volume outliers that hurt in 2025.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_5d
factors.hypothesis: The 20d baseline made the signal flip in 2022 and 2024; a 5d average against a 60d baseline captures persistent attention differences and should be steadier across regimes.

factors.name: aapl_volume_vs_msft_nvda_volume
factors.hypothesis: Comparing Apple's volume surge with the average of both peers reduces idiosyncratic NVDA noise that hurt 2024 while keeping the 2023/2025 gain.

factors.name: aapl_volume_price_range_pressure
factors.hypothesis: High volume combined with wide range signals capitulation or climactic moves that tend to revert next day, a nonlinear interaction the existing factors lack.

factors.name: msft_nvda_minus_qqq_5d
factors.hypothesis: Whether big tech leaders outperform the index shows breadth/leadership in the tech sector, which may influence Apple's next day follow-through.

factors.name: qqq_return_vs_aapl_vol_state
factors.hypothesis: A volatility-normalized QQQ move describes the market state; combined with Apple's relative volume it should tell whether the attention surge is market driven or Apple specific.

factors.name: aapl_minus_qqq_gap_3d_mean
factors.hypothesis: Persistent 10-day Apple relative strength vs QQQ combined with a relative volume surge indicates whether Apple attention is accompanied by sustained leadership or lag.
